[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for Palak Paneer with detailed ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Palak Paneer Recipe:  
- Servings: 4-6  
- Ingredients for palak puree: 1 bunch fresh spinach leaves, 1 small onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 small green chili, 1/2 teaspoon ghee or oil, salt.  
- Ingredients for paneer and sauce: 250 gm paneer, 2 tablespoons ghee or oil, 1 small onion, 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, 1 cup milk or heavy cream, 1/4 cup water, fresh cilantro.  
- Instructions for making palak puree and paneer sauce, combining them, and serving.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips and variations for the Palak Paneer recipe, including using fresh spinach and adjusting spice levels.
